input.content:
Thanks, Ava — you're verified! Unfortunately, I'm not able to remove a single item from a pending order. Here's what I can do instead:

1. Cancel the entire pending order (if you'd like to re-order without the jacket).
2. Modify the fleece jacket to a different option of the same product (e.g., a different color or size) — though the item itself would remain in the order.

If you'd like to go with one of these, could you give me the order ID (it starts with '#W')? Or I can help you find it.
